card.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
card.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on the promotion. First application, wasn't it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I've tried four times. Yours must have been exceptionally legible.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could help you with your next one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How generous. One successful form and you're ready to teach me. They really have picked a fast learner.

reason: Prior self-reread found resentment plateaued. New interaction gives A a concrete competitive stake and B a helpful offer that provokes a more revealing compliment.
